plugins.name: 基础卡片
plugins.description: 展示单行信息卡与双列摘要卡，适用于已核实的结论、说明、资源、趋势和状态。

en.name: Basic Cards
en.description: Show full-width information cards and two-column summary cards for verified findings, explanations, resources, trends, and status.

plugins.name: Cloudflare
plugins.description: 查看域名、流量、DNS、Workers 与 Pages，并由 Agent 安全管理常用操作。

en.name: Cloudflare
en.description: View zones, traffic, DNS, Workers, and Pages, and let the Agent safely manage common operations.

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.description: 查看个人概览、贡献日历和仓库概览卡片，以及管理 Issue 与 Pull Request。

en.name: GitHub
en.description: View profile, contribution calendar, and repository cards, and manage issues and pull requests.

plugins.name: Notion
plugins.description: 查找和阅读已授权的 Notion 页面、数据源，并在确认后创建页面或追加内容。

en.name: Notion
en.description: Find and read authorized Notion pages and data sources, then create pages or append content with confirmation.

plugins.name: 服务器管理
plugins.description: 展示服务器或 NAS 状态，并在 Agent 选定的运行环境中查询 Docker 容器卡片

en.name: Server Management
en.description: Show server or NAS status and inspect Docker containers in the Agent's selected environment.

plugins.name: Telegram 群消息
plugins.description: 读取群消息、选群、回复和投票，并在确认后管理群消息与成员

en.name: Telegram Groups
en.description: Read group messages, choose a group, reply, and vote; manage messages and members with confirmation.

plugins.name: X / Twitter
plugins.description: 免登录查看公开帖子、线程、用户与趋势；配置 X 开发者令牌后搜索，并经用户令牌管理自己的帖子、点赞、收藏和转发。

en.name: X / Twitter
en.description: Read public posts, threads, profiles, timelines, and trends; use X API tokens for search and account actions.

plugins.name: V2EX
plugins.description: 免登录浏览热门与最新主题；配置个人访问令牌后读取节点、主题和提醒，并发帖、回复及管理自己的主题。

en.name: V2EX
en.description: Browse trending and recent topics without signing in. Add a personal access token to read nodes, topics, and notifications, and to post or manage your topics.
